shots.name: tool-toggle-now-mid40ms
shots.setup: (async () => { const q = () => document.querySelector('[data-row-id="reconvene-toggle-run"] button.cv-tool[aria-expanded]'); const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); q()?.click(); await wait(600); q()?.click(); await new Promise((r) => requestAnimationFrame(() => r())); for (const a of document.getAnimations()) { a.pause(); a.currentTime = 40; } })()
